comparison.objective: Build and tighten a strap-clamp stack on a mill table; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a step block and slotted strap around a stud, then tighten a nut, versus support a long rail while engaging spring prongs at separated posts and fastening screws.
comparison.success_condition: Tests strap level, toe/heel support, nut/washer compression, and pull resistance; candidate tests rack-unit registration, four-prong retention, spring extension, prescribed screw holes, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both concern load-bearing hardware, but one tests workholding-stack construction and the other staged rack-rail latching.
